summary.text: Dana Charles is the Republican candidate for Colorado State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
A healthcare executive, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a fourth-generation Coloradan and lifelong Pueblo County resident.

paragraphs.text: In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Dana Charles said she has worked in the healthcare industry for almost 25 years and has served on numerous boards and commissions.
She described herself as a mother of two sons, married to her husband, Greg, and said she entered the race in February 2025.
Charles listed crime and safety and cost of living and affordability as her key campaign messages.
She said the third priority has shifted during the campaign among rural healthcare, concerns about the Aspen Acres Fire, and education.
